scope: cortex + plasma membrane + nuclear envelope ONLY. MT, IF, filopodium, lamellipodium and stress fibres are built elsewhere and are NOT in these totals.
may_not_claim: any physics — no force is computed and no law is bound
that the geometry is correct because it built

R_cell_um.source: laws/cell_geometry.MCF7_GEOMETRY — MCF7 cell volume 1760 um^3 (BNID 115154, Gamcsik 1995 via Wagner 2011) -> sphere-equivalent R 7.49 um; confirmed by photoacoustic sizing n=37.

h_cortex_um.source: h_cortex ~ 200 nm (KB-3.1 / KB-3.5; Salbreux 2012 TCB, Charras 2008 BJ, Clark 2013 10.1016/j.bpj.2013.05.057), quoted in laws/cortex_assembly.py:61.

cortex_areal_density_um2.source: actin filament areal density ~100 um^-2 (KB-3.18); read back from laws/cortex_assembly.CortexParams rather than retyped.

cortex_contour_um.source: laws/cortex_assembly.CortexParams.L_filament_um. ⚠ PARAM_PROVENANCE_AUDIT 2026-07-24 rates 3.0 um CONVENIENCE (coarse): sourced formin ~1 um / Arp2/3 ~0.1 um means 3-30x TOO LONG, and the Arp2/3 short-filament population (~1/3 of cortical actin by mass) is a MISSING ARCHITECTURE rather than a wrong number. Carried forward unchanged so this phase changes one axis, not two.

cortex_seg_um.source: cortical mesh / crosslink spacing 50-100 nm (Morone 2006, Bovellan 2014, Chugh & Paluch 2018); the FLOOR of that band, directed by the PI 2026-08-20. It replaces the incumbent's 0.5 um, which the audit rates CONVENIENCE with 0 KB rows and 5-10x TOO COARSE. ⚠ The band CEILING (0.100 um) is equally sourced and halves the cortex node count; which end is used is a PI decision, not a derivation, and it is recorded here as one.

membrane_mesh_um.source: same band, read as an upper bound: the membrane mesh must be no COARSER than 100 nm, so the subdivision is the coarsest level lying inside the band. That rule returns 7 at R_cell, which is the level WORLD_PORT_PLAN and PI 2026-07-22 both name — reached from the spacing rather than typed.

envelope_mesh_um.source: PI-GAP: no lamin meshwork spacing is registered in this repository. The value used is the cortical/membrane-skeleton mesh band (50-100 nm; Morone 2006, Bovellan 2014, Chugh & Paluch 2018), which is a property of the actin-spectrin cortex and NOT of the nuclear lamina. This is an analogy, not a derivation, and the subdivision it produces inherits that status.

nc_ratio.source: nucleus:cell RADIUS ratio 0.68 +/- 0.08 — imaging flow cytometry n=2164 (PMC7000884) and photoacoustic n=37 (10.1007/s10765-016-2129-y), both 0.68. ⚠ CONFLICT: components/incumbent/compartments.py carries r_eq_um = 5.0 labelled 'provisional geometry; PI GAP'. The sourced ratio gives 5.10 um. The laws/ value is used; the conflict is reported, not closed.

seed.source: RNG seed for the cortical filament frames. Not physiological: it selects one realisation of the quenched disorder, and a conclusion that depends on it is a conclusion about one draw.

populations.density_provenance: actin filament areal density ~100 um^-2 (KB-3.18); read back from laws/cortex_assembly.CortexParams rather than retyped.

populations.mesh_provenance: same band, read as an upper bound: the membrane mesh must be no COARSER than 100 nm, so the subdivision is the coarsest level lying inside the band. That rule returns 7 at R_cell, which is the level WORLD_PORT_PLAN and PI 2026-07-22 both name — reached from the spacing rather than typed.

PI-GAP: no lamin meshwork spacing is registered in this repository. The value used is the cortical/membrane-skeleton mesh band (50-100 nm; Morone 2006, Bovellan 2014, Chugh & Paluch 2018), which is a property of the actin-spectrin cortex and NOT of the nuclear lamina. This is an analogy, not a derivation, and the subdivision it produces inherits that status.

memory.warp_mempool_high_note: Warp allocator high-water mark. Every byte this build allocates goes through it; the CUDA context does not.
memory.device_used_note: device-WIDE, so it carries the CUDA context and any other process on the card. Not a per-process figure.
memory.exact_peak_gpu_bytes_status: NOT MEASURED. The ledger's exact_peak_gpu_bytes is NVML per-process maxMemoryUsage, which needs driver accounting mode enabled before the process starts. The only implementation in this repository is components/incumbent/gpu_memory_accounting.py, and world/ may not import components/ (test_layer_directions). Porting it into a layer world/ may import is an open item; the two figures above are what this module can measure, named for what they are.

invariants.verification_note: read back from what the kernels wrote; the topology entry is an EXACT comparison against strand.build_strand, which is what makes the claim-model change bookkeeping rather than geometry.
